verdict.rationale: Shopify documents public POS UI extension APIs (shopify.dev/docs/api/pos-ui-extensions) whose Target APIs read data and perform POS operations such as updating carts and applying discounts, and extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API. However, these APIs run inside the POS app interface as extensions rather than as a standalone external API that an agent could use to drive POS remotely, and the Admin API evidence is about the broader Shopify platform. Missing for 10: a documented external POS-specific API for headless or agent-driven control, auth and rate-limit documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Target APIs read data and perform operations in Shopify POS like updating cart details, applying discounts, or showing a toast.
Extensions can also [query the GraphQL Admin API directly](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/pos-ui-extensions/latest#direct-api-access) using standard `fetch()` calls.
With Shopify POS UI extensions, you can add custom functionality directly into Shopify's point-of-sale interface.
